Segnala offerta di lavoro Description Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in helping shape the future of movies and television? Do you want to help define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching? Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at any time and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on This role can be based in Milan or Rome. Key job responsibilities Support campaign development from title conception to launch across strategy, creative and talent Build out and communicate marketing campaign from campaign positioning, to strategic pillars for both IT campaigns and Global campaigns. Lead creative development of core marketing assets Support talent management with studio and cross functional team throughout the campaign Partner and collaborate with a wide-range of internal (ranging from Studios, PR, Insights, legal...) and external (agencies, production companies) stakeholders to ensure coherent and timely campaign delivery. Lead post campaign analysis and reporting About The Team This is an amazing time to join Prime Video International Originals marketing team, with an exciting 2026-2027 line up. 2025 saw exciting content such as Culpa Nuestra, Maxton Hall S2, Dimelo Bajito, Marfil, and 2026 will continue with exciting titles such as Perfectos Mentirosos and some additional amazing releases. Join the International Originals team which has an incredible energy, for those who want to have an impact and create the signature initiatives that will connect with our audience in an authentic way! Basic Qualifications Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns Experience building Marketing Strategies, executing marketing campaigns from concept to completion. Headquartered in Dubai, with operational hubs in Mendrisio, London and New York, and a design hub in Milan, SPORTLUX runs brands end-to-end across strategy, design, go-to-market, wholesale and DTC. About the Role The Digital Marketing Manager is responsible for leading Dickies Europe’s digital strategy, ensuring a consistent brand experience across all digital touchpoints while contributing to both brand awareness and business growth objectives. Working cross-functionally with Branding, E-commerce, Sales and external partners, this role will develop and implement digital initiatives focused on customer acquisition, conversion, retention and overall digital performance. Key Responsibilities Digital Strategy Develop and execute the overall digital marketing strategy for Europe. Translate business and marketing objectives into actionable digital plans. Identify growth opportunities and optimization initiatives across all digital channels. Paid Media Lead the paid media strategy across Meta, TikTok, Google and other relevant platforms. Ensure media investments support both brand-building and performance objectives. CRM & Customer Retention Define and oversee the CRM and email marketing strategy. Manage customer segmentation, automation flows and loyalty initiatives. Drive customer retention and lifetime value through data-driven communication strategies. Oversee the implementation and ongoing development of CRM tools and platforms. E-commerce Growth Drive customer acquisition and online revenue growth through performance marketing initiatives. Develop and manage affiliate marketing programs to generate incremental sales. Identify new digital growth opportunities across paid acquisition, affiliate partnerships and conversion optimization. Work closely with E-commerce and CRM teams to improve conversion, ROAS and customer lifetime value. Analytics & Performance Monitor and analyse the performance of all digital channels. Produce regular reporting and actionable insights. Identify opportunities to improve traffic, acquisition, conversion and retention metrics. Agency & Partner Management Coordinate and manage paid media, CRM and other digital partners. Ensure the successful delivery of campaigns and projects within agreed timelines. Manage budgets and evaluate partner performance against business objectives. Digital Ecosystem Management Ensure alignment between digital initiatives, commercial goals and brand strategy. Identify new opportunities to strengthen the brand’s digital presence and drive growth. Profile 5-8 years of experience in Digital Marketing, E-commerce, CRM and/or Performance Marketing roles. Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms, preferably Klaviyo. Experience managing or collaborating on Shopify-based e-commerce environments. Familiarity with customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, automation flows and retention strategies. Previous experience within fashion, lifestyle, sportswear, streetwear, consumer brands or culturally relevant consumer businesses. testo_completo: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Team The Business Operations & Strategy (BOS) team sits within the Italian commercial organisation. It gives the commercial teams their direction through targets, instructions, processes and tools, keeps the operating pace, and runs the operations that deliver our business objectives. As Commercial Strategy Manager you connect strategy to execution at country level: you help shape how the commercial organisation deploys its people and its investment, you steer the country's strategic programmes, and you make sure global frameworks become local ways of working. You report to the Head of BOS, who is part of the local commercial leadership team. This is a role for someone who sees what is missing and builds it, without waiting to be asked. What You’ll Be Doing Shape country and regional strategy. Help define where Italy invests, where it defends and where it monetises, by turning market and performance data into a clear view of priorities across regions and cities. Equip Regional Managers to plan. Regional Managers own their City and Regional Plans. You give them a shared framework of analysis and a common method, so plans are built on the same logic and can be compared and consolidated into the country view. You support them as they draft, test their assumptions, and turn what works into repeatable local playbooks that any region can apply. Drive strategic programmes across regions. Own cross-region strategic programmes from intent to delivery, using the same frameworks and methods. You provide that structure and keep it running through governance, risk management and regular steering. Connect central and local. You adapt them to local conditions and field reality, act as the day-to-day contact for central teams, and bring local learning back to central. Plan the organisation and the sales force. Support the design of the commercial organisation and the planning of its capacity: how the team is structured, how coverage and capacity are sized against the opportunity, how targets are allocated, and how hiring and ramp-up are phased. Plan commercial investment. Support the planning of the investment budget: how resources are allocated across areas and initiatives, which trade-offs are accepted, and how return is measured and reviewed over time. You build the business case that links an investment to its expected impact. Analyse and track. Own the analysis and tracking that sit behind these decisions: define the right measures, establish baselines, and turn data into clear recommendations. Use AI to work faster, and verify what it produces before anyone relies on it. What You’ll Need to Thrive 4-7 years of experience in commercial environments (account management, sales, sales operations or commercial strategy), ideally in a marketplace, delivery or fast-growing B2B business. You know how the field really works, and you have moved, or want to move, into strategy. A track record of running cross-functional programmes without formal authority, and of solving comparable problems in commercial planning: prioritising where to focus, sizing capacity, or allocating budget against objectives. Experience building or supporting commercial plans (market, regional or territory plans) and giving other people a method to follow: a framework or playbook that teams actually adopted. Structured problem solving: you break problems into drivers, go several layers deep on the "why", look for evidence that could prove you wrong, and can state the so-what in one sentence. Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel or Google Sheets, working SQL, and experience with BI dashboards. You are comfortable using AI tools and you verify their output. Clear written and spoken communication in Italian and English, from a field team huddle to a leadership readout. Nice to have: experience designing a framework that other teams or markets adopted; exposure to organisation design, sales force planning, budget planning or incentive design. You go to the lowest level of detail and keep the big picture in view. You act quickly and correct course. You seek the truth in the data, even when it contradicts the plan. You adapt global standards when local needs require it, and you commit fully once a decision is made. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine - our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
